children: Overview
India real estate developer's Q2 consolidated revenue from operations dips to INR 4.97 bln
Q2 consolidated net profit rose to INR 1.0 bln
Outlook
Company did not provide specific guidance for future quarters or the full year in the press release
Result Drivers
ASSOCIATES AND JOINT VENTURES – H1 profit before tax benefited from INR 743.2 mln share of profit, versus a loss yr ago
HIGHER FINANCE COSTS – H1 finance costs roughly doubled, weighing on profit
INVENTORY MOVEMENT – Expenses benefited from a INR 380.4 mln inventory reduction, versus a INR 923.4 mln increase a year earlier
